= The Ethical Philosophy of Autonomous Artificial Intelligence in Warfare =
Title: The Ethical Philosophy of Autonomous Artificial Intelligence in Warfare
Author: Dr. Daniel J. Richardson III
Publisher: InDepth Global AI
Publication Date: 3/27/2025
ISBN: 979-8315831747
Website: https://a.co/d/bDBLLm3
The Ethical Philosophy of Autonomous Artificial Intelligence in Warfare is a 2025 non-fiction book by Dr. Daniel J. Richardson III, exploring the ethical implications of deploying autonomous artificial intelligence (AAI) systems in military conflict. The book examines topics such as moral agency, accountability, and the legal frameworks governing lethal autonomous weapons systems (LAWS).
#

"A timely and terrifyingly relevant masterpiece. Richardson forces us to confront the ethical abyss of AI warfare before it’s too late." — Yaki Dunietz CEO AI Conversation Systems
